description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class, which manages the connection state to a gateway endpoint, subscribes to updates, and handles endpoint state changes in a macOS application.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class that manages connection states, endpoint URLs, and associated labels for gateway connectivity in a macOS app.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the endpoint subscription task to listen for gateway endpoint state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Handles updates to the endpoint state, updating stored properties and triggering refreshes when the endpoint URL changes.

methods.name: hostLabel(for:)
methods.description: Generates a host label string from a given URL, including port if available.
